text_block_list.text:
On the way back from an outing with Red 
Desire, she suddenly came to a halt.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, how lovely...! They're holding an 
exhibition of natural gemstone jewelry."
choice_data_list: We've got time, so shall we take a look?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Are you sure...! Then, by all means...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Ah...! What a dazzling sparkle... Up 
close, it feels like I'm being drawn right 
in!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
A simple word like "like" doesn't do it 
justice...! A Saint and jewels are 
inseparable, after all!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"A sacred treasure that awakens the 
Saint's purifying powers, and motifs of 
the Seven Knights blessed by the Saint—"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Gems appear in many isekai reincarnation 
stories, often playing a significant role 
for the saintess.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
While I'm in this world, there's no 
telling which gem might turn out to be a 
key item for me!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
From cheap candy prizes to accessories 
discovered overseasâ

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"I make a point of purchasing anything 
where I feel the guiding hand of destiny♪"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Loves-san! Were you guided here by the 
brilliance of the gems as well?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"What a coincidence♪ Did the two of you 
come for the workshop as well?"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. We're working on making amulets out 
of raw gemstone fragments.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: I wanted to give a present to Maru-chan.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I'm just a bit nervous right now with the 
mock race against those strong runners 
coming up, so—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"I want to gift it with love and courage, 
saying, ‘You can definitely win, 
Maru-chan! Because I'm right here with 
you!’♡"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"A gift from a precious childhood friend 
inspires a girl who was on the verge of 
faltering in adversity――"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Ah, how wonderful...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Items imbued with heartfelt feelings will 
surely attract happiness and miracles.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"...I've made up my mind, I'll make one 
too! An item infused with a saint's 
prayer!"

text_block_list.name: Desire & Loves
text_block_list.text: I did it...!
choice_data_list:
You both made it really well, just like 
the lecture taught.

You both made it really well, just like 
the lecture taught.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Yes. But... even if they look identical on 
the outside, each one is truly unique.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
The feelings poured into them, the 
memories about to be woven... All of 
those, too, become the radiance of a gem.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. The amulet I made is 
one-of-a-kind, just for Maru-chan, after 
all. ♡
choice_data_list: Each and every one is one of a kind...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Yes♪

Suddenly... the brooch she had lost before 
crossed my mind.

"Rather than searching endlessly, I passed 
off an identical replica as the real 
thing, but—"

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I give this amulet to you.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"As one who walks beside the Saint, trials 
may sometimes befall you as well."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
May it give you strength along your 
arduous journey.

My throat was completely parched. I can't 
go on like this.

I must repay that gentle kindness— 
Clutching the amulet tight, I steel my 
resolve.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Yes, what can I help you with?
choice_data_list:
……I'll overcome this trial, just you 
watch.
I can feel the saintess's blessing.

text_block_list.text:
Finding the one and only genuine brooch 
and returning it to her—that is my trial.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. I can see your aura overflowing. I 
am sure your wish will be fulfilled.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Because you have a Saint by your side!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Such a warm bond... It's truly love♡

To repay her kindness, I'll do whatever it 
takes and search tirelessly until the 
brooch is found.

"I will definitely get the real brooch 
back into Red Desire's hands!"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Yes♪ Desire-san's amulet is filled with so 
much love, I can feel it♡

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, so you can feel it too. I poured 
plenty of holy power into it, after all.

To repay her kindness, I'll do whatever it 
takes and search tirelessly until the 
brooch is found.

"I will definitely get the real brooch 
back into Red Desire's hands!"
